title: Symmetry of the Matrix Operator
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $A$ be a symmetric real $n\times n$ matrix. For all $x,y\in\mathbb{R}^n$, one has $\langle Ax,y\rangle=\langle x,Ay\rangle$.
